sp-core.name: Signal processing core
sp-core.length: 10 courses, about 3.3 years at two a term
sp-core.goal: The statistical signal processing sequence on its own: detection, estimation and the mathematics under them.
sp-core.tradeoff: No RF content. You will know the algorithms without knowing the hardware they run on.

sp-rf.name: Signal processing and RF, balanced
sp-rf.length: 10 courses, about 3.3 years at two a term
sp-rf.goal: Covers signal processing and RF together rather than either one in depth.
sp-rf.tradeoff: Less depth than either single-subject track. Adaptive filtering and multirate do not fit.

collector-10.name: Receiver systems, in ten
collector-10.length: 10 courses, about 3.3 years at two a term
collector-10.goal: A receiver end to end inside ten courses: fields, front end, programmable logic and software radio.
collector-10.tradeoff: Ten courses leaves no room for an antenna course, so the aperture is the part that gives. Take the full receiver track to design that too.

sme.name: Statistical signal processing, in depth
sme.length: 24 courses, about 8 years at two a term
sme.goal: Depth in statistical signal processing, with enough RF and systems work to follow a receiver end to end.
sme.tradeoff: Light on hardware. You will understand a receiver as a system without having built one.

collector-full.name: Build your own receiver
collector-full.length: 32 courses, about 11 years at two a term
collector-full.goal: Every stage of the signal chain, antenna to processed output, with the bench work to build and test each one. Ordered as the signal travels.
collector-full.tradeoff: Much longer than the others. Covers design, build and test of the whole receiver rather than one layer of it.
